propositions: Prose documentation must enumerate surface-parity census (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason dispositions for each change.
Each config key read by a change must be validated through a test proving the key changes behavior via the real read path, not merely that it is parsed.

Contention-shaped changes (composed locked ops, retry/backoff logic, cache over store state) must add test cases routed to existing shared suites by shape: two_clones, storm suite, or reads-under-sync-contention harness.
Behavioral gate findings must be tested with a RED test first, then fixed in the same change; non-behavioral findings fixed directly without change-detector tests.
A Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate all out-of-scope slots and compromises from the census, then classify each as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed.
